title: Japanese-Style Chicken Wrap
description: A twist on traditional wraps, this Japanese-inspired dish combines roasted chicken with savory flavors and crunchy textures.
instructions: Slice the roasted chicken breast into thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and wasabi mayonnaise.
In a large pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the sliced chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add the pickled ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until softened.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the sushi rice on the Portuguese roll, followed by the cooked chicken, pickled ginger, cucumber, carrots, green onions, and soy sauce.
Note: You can also add other ingredients such as avocado, spinach, or grilled vegetables to suit your taste.
